criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core` (filtered to the new test): a test where a plan has one demonstration with fails_without and the reverted copy makes the named test fail; the verifier brief it builds contains that demonstration's recorded run (command, non-zero exit code, output tail) under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'.
criteria.evidence: The test passed (1 passed). It runs a real job through Athena::go. The plan's demonstration has fails_without set. A demo_seam maps the command to an sh script that exits 1 when README.md lacks the producer's text. The test checks that the section of the Verifier prompt starting at '## Checks Athena ran on this tree' contains 'fails-without-1: not a check', '`cargo test --locked demo`', 'exit code 1', 'failed without the fix (exit 1)', 'Files put back to the base: README.md' and the output-tail lines. Without the new stage there is no such entry, so the test would fail.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core` (filtered to the new test): a test where reverting does not make the named test fail; the brief's record says the test passed without the fix, and it is not presented as a failing run.
criteria.evidence: The test passed. The mapped script prints 'test result: ok. 1 passed' and exits 0. The verifier prompt contains 'exit code 0' and 'passed without the fix: the revert did not make the test fail', and does not contain 'failed without the fix'. The job still lands. The unit test verify::tests::demonstration_view_classifies_by_exit_code_and_tests_ran also passed. It covers the other outcomes: tests that do not compile, no tests run, a run that did not finish, and a tail showing only '0 passed' while tests_ran is Some(1).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: briefs.rs renders the demonstration record in the brief; a rendering test checks the text appears with command, exit code and output tail.
criteria.evidence: All 4 demonstration_record tests passed. demonstration_record_shows_command_exit_code_and_output_tail checks the command in backticks, 'exit code 101', the result sentence, the criteria, the reverted files, the warning about removed tests and the fenced tail with its inner fence neutralised. It also checks that the entry prints no '` passed' or '` failed' status of its own. an_entry_with_no_demonstration_renders_as_before also exists. It is not matched by this filter, but the recorded full test run passed it.

criteria.criterion: The demonstration runs in a scratch copy: Grep/diff of verification.rs (or the checks stage) shows the candidate tree and the candidate commit are not modified, and the scratch copy is removed afterwards.
criteria.evidence: In checks.rs, demonstration_records makes `<job_dir>/revert` with verifier_snapshot, the same Snapshot::create path the verifier's own snapshot uses. All writes and removals go through scratch_target(snapshot.dir(), ..), which refuses '..' and paths through symbolic links. Against the job repository it only calls git.diff_tree and git.show_file, which both read. pin::remove_tree(&dir) runs on every path in the outer function, the same pattern as take_baseline. The criterion 1 test asserts that `revert` no longer exists and that HEAD:README.md still holds the producer's text.

criteria.criterion: The record is an entry that fails nothing ('not a check'), so the final verdict still rests on the recorded fmt, clippy and test checks.
criteria.evidence: demonstration_entry in verify.rs builds CheckResultView { command: "not a check", passed: true, .. }. verification.rs extends only inputs.checks, which is the brief view. check_runs and the judge are untouched. The criterion 1 job lands even though its demonstration exits 1.

criteria.criterion: Outcome-check/tested: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass as recorded under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'.
criteria.evidence: Recorded checks for c4d7cdd2 (CI run 41776051549): fmt passed, clippy passed, test passed. The targeted runs also passed: 11 athena-core 'demonstration' tests (including the no-mapper test and the not-a-plain-command test) and 7 'revert' tests (including the inline test module job test and the revert_plan and revert_keeping_tests unit tests).

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying the verifier now sees Athena's recorded 'fails without the fix' run.
criteria.evidence: Under '### Added' in CHANGELOG.md: 'The verifier now sees Athena's recorded "fails without the fix" run.' The entry names the root cause (the verifier gets no producer report and cannot change files) and describes the scratch-copy revert, the limit of three distinct commands and the not-a-check status. These claims match the code (MAX_DEMONSTRATION_RUNS = 3).

findings.summary: code_health.rs changed but is not on the expected deliverables list (scope)
findings.evidence: The diff adds TestModules and test_module_ranges to code_health.rs (+49 lines). The plan listed this file, the change is a small shared parser helper that the revert needs, and it adds no behaviour beyond the deliverable.

findings.summary: An error from one demonstration's run_check throws away the records of demonstrations that already ran
findings.evidence: demonstration_runs uses `run_check(..)?` inside the loop. An Err ends the whole function, and the outer function then marks every group 'not run: the scratch copy could not be made or run', even groups that finished. Recording the error on that one slot and going on would keep the finished records.

findings.summary: A doc comment says measure_source shares test_module_ranges, but it does not call it
findings.evidence: The doc comment calls test_module_ranges 'the one definition of a test module that measure_source and the demonstration revert share'. A grep shows that only verify.rs calls test_module_ranges. The two share is_cfg_test.

summary: The change passes. After the producer finishes, Athena now runs each planned "fails without the fix" demonstration itself, in a scratch copy (`<job_dir>/revert`) of the candidate with the fix reverted and the tests kept. It shows the command, exit code, a one-sentence result and the end of the output to the verifier under "Checks Athena ran on this tree". Each record is a "not a check" entry that fails nothing. I ran the new tests and they pass. The job-level test where the reverted copy fails shows "exit code 1" and "failed without the fix" in the verifier's prompt. The test where the revert changes nothing shows "passed without the fix" and no failing wording. The briefs.rs rendering tests pass. Further tests cover an inline `#[cfg(test)]` module, a command that is not a plain `cargo test`, and a build with no test seam installed. The candidate commit is never written to, and the scratch copy is removed on every path. The test-support feature is enabled only in dev-dependencies (Cargo resolver 3), so the released binary always runs the demonstrations. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed for this commit. All seven criteria are met. There are three small findings: code_health.rs changed although it is not on the deliverables list (the plan listed it, and it is a small shared helper); one failed run throws away the records of runs that already finished; and one doc comment is inaccurate.
